title: 音乐播放器
description: 管理歌曲与歌单，持续播放并显示滚动歌词。
author: 资源管理器项目

catalog.usage: 从左侧音乐入口管理歌曲与歌单，在右侧歌词面板播放和查看滚动歌词。

en.歌单已删除，歌曲保留；可以撤销（{value1}）: Playlist deleted. Songs retained. Undo with {value1}.
en.只删除这份歌单及排列，歌曲、原文件和歌词保留。本次操作可以撤销。: Deletes the playlist and its order. Songs, originals and lyrics are retained. You can undo this.
en.已加入歌单，可以撤销: Added to playlist. You can undo this.
en.仅保存你的修正，不改写音频原文件；留空时继续使用文件中的信息。: Saves your corrections in the library. Leave a field empty to use the audio file’s metadata. The original is preserved.
en.请等待文件读取完成: Wait for the file to finish loading
en.[00:00.00]第一句歌词\n[00:08.50]第二句歌词\n\n也可以粘:
[00:00.00]First lyric line
[00:08.50]Second lyric line

You can also paste plain lyrics without timestamps.
en.歌词延后（秒，负数为提前）: Lyric delay (seconds; use a negative value to advance)
en.曲名相同，专辑不同，请确认版本: Same track title, different album. Check the version.
en.曲名相同，时长不同，请确认版本: Same track title, different duration. Check the version.
en.文件名匹配，请确认歌曲与版本: File name matches. Check the track and version.
en.曲名相同，缺少歌手信息: Track title matches; artist information is missing.
en.曲名、歌手一致，未发现版本冲突: Track and artist match with no known version conflict.
en.已匹配仓库歌词：{label}；可以撤销: Matched library lyrics: {label}. You can undo this.
en.已采用仓库歌词，可以撤销: Library lyrics applied. You can undo this.
en.选择一首歌曲，播放时会自动查找仓库歌词。: Choose a track. Playing it searches the library for lyrics.
en.这首歌已有歌词记录，自动匹配不会覆盖。可通过下方按钮编辑。: This track already has lyrics. Automatic matching preserves them. Use the button below to edit.
en.份文件正在建立索引，完成后会重新匹配。: files are being indexed. Matching will resume when indexing finishes.
en.份文件未能读取，可在文件的歌词索引中查看原因。: files could not be read. See the lyrics index for details.
en.没有找到匹配的歌词。把 LRC 文件收进仓库，或使用下方“添加歌词”。: No matching lyrics found. Collect an LRC file or choose Add lyrics below.
en.请选择与这首歌对应的版本。只有唯一明确的匹配会在播放时自动采用。: Choose the version that matches this track. Only a single unambiguous match is applied automatically during playback.
en.把喜欢的歌曲放在一起。: Collect your favorite tracks in one place.
en.点击 ＋ 创建第一份歌单。: Click ＋ to create your first playlist.
en.选择一首歌曲，歌词会在这里展开: Choose a song to see its lyrics here
en.临时编排，独立于歌单保存。: Temporary play order, separate from saved playlists.
en.播放歌曲，或将歌曲加入队列。: Play a track or add tracks to the queue.
en.音乐窗口会话未挂载: Music session unavailable in this window
en.播放状态无法保存到本机: Could not save playback state on this device
en.这首歌曲已移除或音频不可用；可以切到下一首: Track removed or audio unavailable. Try the next track.
en.音频转换不可用，请检查 ffmpeg 与音频插件: Audio conversion unavailable. Check FFmpeg and the audio plugin.
en.无法解码此音频，请确认文件存在且格式受支持: Could not decode audio. Check that the file exists and its format is supported.
en.未能播放，请重试或检查音频格式: Could not play. Try again or check the audio format.
en.搜索曲名、艺术家、专辑或歌词…: Search titles, artists, albums or lyrics…
en.在全部歌曲中多选，再加入这份歌单。: Select tracks in All tracks and add them to this playlist.
en.将音频文件拖进仓库，解析完成后会出现在这里。: Drag audio files into the library. Tracks appear here after processing.
en.管理歌曲与歌单，持续播放并显示滚动歌词。: Organize tracks and playlists, keep music playing and follow synced lyrics.
en.从左侧音乐入口管理歌曲与歌单，在右侧歌词面板播放和查看滚动歌词。: Open Music in navigation to manage tracks and playlists. Use the lyrics panel for playback and synced lyrics.

en.field.musicLyricSource.name: Original file name
